rows: Moses carries responsibility for the people without being their biological parent.
A governing or supporting relationship must not become a biological-generation edge.
Existing elders are brought into shared responsibility.
Selection and participation do not create new entities.
The burden is to be shared with Moses.
This passage does not enact his replacement. Succession and shared orchestration remain different operations.
